text.p: -- UBS Securities analyst Samuel Navarro said he had raised his rating on Gynecare Inc to buy from hold, with a 12- to 18-month target price of $11-$12.

-- "We believe the FDA approval of (Gynecare's) VersaPoint fibroid removal system, coupled with significant progress taking place at the company, mark a reversal for the stock price that should continue well beyond yesterday's move," Navarro said in a research note.
-- The VersaPoint System is designed to reduce the risks of traditional surgical fibroid removal procedures, Gynecare said. The system enables gynecologists to vaporize, cut or dessicate tissue.
